# sottools

This package mostly contains functions to help retrieve data from the
national waiting times data mart for further analysis using R.

## Installation

Execute the below code in the console to install sottools:

``` r

pak::pak("Public-Health-Scotland/sottools")
```

## Registering Credentials

To connect with the waiting times warehouse using this package you will
need to set up a keyring to store your LDAP password. Instructions for
doing so can be found in
[`vignette("warehouse-credentials")`](https://public-health-scotland.github.io/sottools/articles/warehouse-credentials.md).

## Example

This is a very basic example of retrieving data from the warehouse:

``` r

library(sottools)
library(dplyr)

con <- wh_connection()

comp_m <- get_wh_tbl(con, "SSM", "completed")

comp_m |> 
  count() |> 
  collect()
```

A more extensive guide to using sottools to query the warehouse can be
found in
[`vignette("sottools")`](https://public-health-scotland.github.io/sottools/articles/sottools.md).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`apply_publication_filters()`](https://public-health-scotland.github.io/sottools/reference/apply_publication_filters.md)
  : Filter out records not reported on in the SoT publication
- [`create_analysis_variables()`](https://public-health-scotland.github.io/sottools/reference/create_analysis_variables.md)
  : Create derived variables
- [`get_wh_tbl()`](https://public-health-scotland.github.io/sottools/reference/get_wh_tbl.md)
  : Get a lazy_tbl object from the warehouse
- [`month_end_dates()`](https://public-health-scotland.github.io/sottools/reference/month_end_dates.md)
  : Get a vector of month-end dates
- [`s_performance()`](https://public-health-scotland.github.io/sottools/reference/s_performance.md)
  : Create Performance Summary Table
- [`wh_connection()`](https://public-health-scotland.github.io/sottools/reference/wh_connection.md)
  : Connect to the warehouse
